items.title: Message settings page shows notification sound picker
steps: Click the settings (gear) control in the Messages inbox header
Confirm page has icon-only chrome (back + settings icons) — no 'Message settings' h1 or subtitle
Confirm notification sounds section is visible with toggle, sound grid, and Save button
items.expected: Full sound picker UI lives on Message settings with icon header only; not on Account settings.
items.evidence: 2026-08-05 static verification after dev integration: MessageSettingsPage mounts NotificationSoundsSettings; InboxView links to /messages/settings; App.tsx registers the static route before /messages/:conversationId.
items.notes: Source-level route and composition verification completed; interactive rendering remains covered by the manual PR smoke check.

items.title: Account settings no longer shows notification sounds
items.precondition: Signed in; own profile → Account settings (/settings)
items.expected: Only Privacy, Security, and More settings stubs remain. No notification sound picker. Page subtitle no longer mentions notification preferences.
items.evidence: 2026-08-05 static verification: AccountSettingsPage contains only Privacy, Security, and More settings blocks and no NotificationSoundsSettings import or render.
items.notes: Source-level composition verification completed; interactive rendering remains covered by the manual PR smoke check.

items.title: Sound preferences still persist and play after move
items.precondition: Two mutuals; sounds enabled; socket connected; user unlocked audio
steps: On /messages/settings, pick a sound and save
With peer on Feed, receive inbound DM — hear selected sound
Toggle sounds off on Message settings, save — inbound DM is silent
items.expected: localStorage keys unchanged; playback hook in AppShell still gates on same prefs.
items.evidence: 2026-08-05 static verification: notificationSounds.ts and useMessageNotificationSound.ts are outside this PR diff; npm run typecheck and npm run build pass (re-run in this review-remediation commit).
items.notes: Playback requires two authenticated mutual users, a connected socket, and browser audio unlocked by a user gesture.
items.waiver: Manual two-browser audio acceptance remains required before merge; this workspace has no isolated two-user runtime or audio device evidence. This explicit waiver is limited to the live playback portion of A3.
